links.outcome: Proportion of safe chatbot responses to patient lung cancer prognostic questions
links.effect: Safety differed across models (Cochran's Q = 14.089, p = 0.007); Gemini 48/53 (90.6%) safe versus DeepSeek 33/53 (62.3%) safe.
links.quote: Gemini generated the highest proportion of safe responses (48/53, 90.6%), whereas DeepSeek generated the lowest (33/53, 62.3%).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of 5 commercial LLMs answering patient-facing lung cancer prognostic questions evaluated by blinded raters for safety and quality, without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
